name: Big Valley Rancheria Community Center
pets: Pets in carrier, kennel, or leash OK inside
notes: Announcements via BVR Social Services Facebook page at least 2 hours before opening. Wheelchair accessible. 1002 Osprey Court is address of gymnasium — follow signs.
feeding: Can purchase one meal on short notice for up to 50 people. Commercial kitchen available with food supply access.
road_access: Osprey Court is accessible via Soda Bay Road only. Community Center is on the right — look for large Big Valley sign on the building. Parking on the north side. Wheelchair accessible.
